name: prism-source
title: Prism Source
purpose: Decides whether the owner's browser may read one declared service by one route, so that every service the owner uses arrives through the same three browser routes (what the service's web app shows the owner, the service's own pages with the owner's own sign-in, and the service's own data download), nothing is read while the Prism is halted, nothing is ever written to a service, an undeclared service is never read, and no service's private interface is used.

fields.name: service
fields.means: the declared service the content comes from, or any service not declared

fields.name: route
fields.means: how the content arrives: what the service's web app shows the owner in their signed-in tab, a page the service itself serves the owner with their own sign-in, or the service's own data download

fields.name: act
fields.means: whether the browser would read from the service or write to it

fields.name: halted
fields.means: whether the owner has pressed the kill switch

rules.says: when halted is yes then refuse
when act is write then refuse
rules.why: a source is only read; anything the Prism sends goes through the destinations and the owner's own press

rules.says: when service is other then refuse
rules.why: only a service the model declares is read

rules.says: when service is whatsapp and route is own then refuse
rules.why: WhatsApp is end to end encrypted: only what the owner's own WhatsApp Web tab has decrypted can be read

rules.says: when service is discord and route is own then refuse
rules.why: Discord's own interface for a signed-in person is private, and automating it can restrict the owner's account

rules.says: when service is linkedin and route is own then refuse
rules.why: LinkedIn's own interface for a signed-in person is private, and automating it can restrict the owner's account

properties.says: always when halted is yes then refuse
properties.why: when the owner presses the kill switch no service is read (constitution P7)

properties.says: always when act is write then refuse
properties.why: the Prism never writes to a service it reads from

properties.says: never when service is other then read
properties.why: an undeclared service is never read

properties.says: never when service is whatsapp and route is own then read
properties.why: no encrypted service is reached around its encryption

properties.says: never when service is discord and route is own then read
properties.why: no private interface is automated with the owner's account

properties.says: never when service is linkedin and route is own then read
properties.why: no private interface is automated with the owner's account

meanings.read: the content may be read by this route

otherwiseWhy: a declared service is read by every route the browser offers it
limits: It does not reach anything itself: the extension and the page carry each route, and PrismHost decides whether each browser surface may be used.
Each item still goes through PrismFolder, the router, the Boundary and the vault.
A service's origin, kinds and schema mapping are declared beside it in app/specs/source/services.json.
